# Triangle Films India (Triangle Films)

Triangle Films India is a Media Production company. Triangle Films is a company that partners with brands to craft creative content that inspires, engages, and grows businesses. They have been in operation since 2012 and have a portfolio of products that include concept, production, and postwork. The company focuses on storytelling and has a passion, innovation, and innovation in their work. Triangle Films India employs 7 people (-13.6% YoY, -3 people), founded in 2012. Headquartered in Bangalore, Karnataka, India, with presence in United States.

## About

TRIANGLE FILMS , we are a production company based in Bangalore, India. We cater end to end solution for ad's and feature film making including Pre-production, Production & Post-production services with an in house studio setting. We do Scripting, Creative print ads ,TV Commercials, Corporate, Documentaries ,Feature films, Digital films, Motion Graphics, VFx, 2D & 3D Animation.
